lines.en: : Aaaaaaand we’re back! And not a second too soon as both of this competition’s participants have been beginning to get a little testy while Sensei was off getting confessed to!
: I am ready to murder Touka.
: And I am ready to get this silly contest over with.
: And I’m ready to...probably be very uncomfortable.
: Now, not counting the two competitions that are still going on over on the other end of the beach, we’ve only got two left for you folks at home.

: But! They’re sure to be two of the most exciting competitions of the entire contest! And I’m not just saying that because this year’s Dorm Wars was very hastily planned and kinda all over the place!
: Doesn’t matter! Release the uncle!

: Nuh-uh, Ami! For today and today only, Sensei will be your beloved son! And you will be one of two doting mothers. Just think back to last year’s competition and do that, but in a hopefully less creepy way!
: Uta, who am I waving at exactly?
: The viewers! Just keep smiling and waving, Karin! You got this!
: Oh...uhh...okay! Hi...viewers...I’m Karin Kanda...And I guess I’m a...judge for this competition too...
: No judging will be necessary, Karin. This competition is over already.
: I can’t help but feel like I am being somewhat underestimated right now.
: And I can’t help but feel very excited to watch two teenage girls pamper an adult male. Remind me, Uta — will breastfeeding be on the table?
: It will not! We do want to keep this competition fair after all!
: What’s your game, Nagasawa? Why do you keep following me around? And why are you suggesting competitions that will do nothing but make my flaws more visible?
: Because I would like your flaws to be more visible. Particularly if they also happen to be getting suckled by our very own-
: Hahah! Time for a commercial break!
: But we don’t have any-
HEY KIDS! DO YOU WANT TO GET YOUR HANDS ON THE SINGLE GREATEST MOBILE GAME OF ALL TIME?! BECAUSE IF YOU DON’T, YOU’RE A FUCKING IDIOT!
RAID SHADOW LEGENDS IS BACK AGAIN TO PUNCH YOU IN THE FUCKING FACE WITH BRAND NEW CHAMPIONS!
SO MANY NEW CHAMPIONS THAT YOU’LL THINK TO YOURSELF “HOLY SHIT! THAT’S SO MANY CHAMPIONS!”
AND TO THAT, WE HERE AT PLARIUM GAMES WOULD LIKE TO SAY “FUCK YOU, JIMMY! KEEP DRAWING, YOU PIECE OF SHIT.”
BUT OF COURSE THAT IS JUST A HYPOTHETICAL SCENARIO! WE HAVEN’T KIDNAPPED ANYONE NAMED JIMMY!
: Jimmy no!
JIMMY YES!
: mom help
SHE CAN’T. YOU HAVE A JOB TO DO, JIMMY.
: i want to go home and play video games again. i am no longer happy chained to this computer plarium games. i want to be free.
IN SEVEN MORE YEARS YOU MIGHT BE. CHIN UP, JIMMY.

: but that’s so long and it might leave a hole inside of me that will make it impossible to figure out my real identity as my real identity will be split between all of the characters in the game by then and-
STOP COMPLAINING AND PRODUCE MORE CONTENT. GO GO GO GO GO GO GO GO.
: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
: And there he is! The man of the hour! How’d the confession battle go, Sensei?
: Uhh...good I think?
: Well, don’t tell us the winner just yet! We’ll reveal the final rankings as a big surprise tomorrow morning. But of course, no surprise can be complete without...two girls mom’ing it up over you!
: Was that supposed to be a segue?
: Like I said before you showed up. Hastily prepared.
: But how would I know anything that happened before I-
: Never mind that, Sensei. Just let Uta and Karin explain the rules to you so I can win and we can all go home.
: Question — why is Karin doing so much work this weekend?
: Because she is one of the few kindhearted people on this beach and is not capable of saying no.
: It’s true. And Hi, Sensei. We haven’t really gotten to talk at all this-
: Doesn’t matter. Now shut up and listen to the rules.
: Ami, you’re doing the thing again.
: Crap! I am, aren’t I?
: Yeah, what happened to the whole “I’m gonna be a better Ami” thing from last night? You already backtrackin’ on your own words?
: Now, now. I’m sure she’s just excited to compete. There’s nothing quite like the love a fake mother has for her fake son, after all.
: No, there’s really not. But I’m not sure if it’s in the way you were intending to get across right there.
: I’ll listen to the rules in a second. I do have one other question first, though.
: Why is she here?
: Since when do I need a reason to place myself where all of the incest is happening?
: Okay! Time for another commercial-
: Karin, stop! They haven’t paid us enough for all these time slots!
: She’s been following me around ever since the poetry thing, Sensei! It’s starting to creep me out!
: Nodoka, I understand that you may have given up Wakana in exchange for her cooperation in...getting Noriko to hug me. But there are more suitable replacements for her than Ami.
: Like who?
: Obviously Touka.
: Um, hello? I am right here. Please do not volunteer me to be stalked.
: I suppose that just leaves Uta then...
: Hahah...hah...
: No.
: And Karin.
: Shh...there are simply some things that should just never be corrupted, Sensei.
: Nodoka, why are you here? For real.

: Curiosity, of course. You see, I’ve been feeling a little...unmotivated ever since our vacation started. And I just happen to believe observing your beloved niece for a little while will help me get back on track.
: Do I love attention? Yes. But this is not the kind of attention I want. This just makes me feel weird.
: Well, there’s nothing I can do about it. This is clearly Nodoka’s world and we’re all just living in it.
: Yeah, I’m sure that’s not gonna set off any alarms.
: The rules of the contest are simple, Sensei! And for the sake of keeping things brief, we’ve decided to allow each contestant one motherly task of their choosing to complete.
: Their effectiveness in completing these tasks will obviously be determined by you! And after each one of them gets to go, you’ll be free to pick whoever was the most motherly!
: Also, any and all physical contact must be approved by the council of judges before taking place. We don’t want things getting too crazy after all.
: Is the council of judges just you and Karin?
: And me.
: Nodoka is not a judge. The council is just me and Karin.
: In that case, may I beseech the council for its approval in allowing physical contact between Sensei and me? The task of my choosing can not be completed without it.
: Touka is asking for physical contact permission?! But that’s a rule we made to deal with Ami!
: Yeah! I’m the physical contact girl!
: I wonder if breastfeeding is being permitted after all...
: Same here.
: Don’t be a pig.
: Just so you know, I’d be really mad right now if I was allowed to be.
: Touka, um...just what sort of...physical contact are you looking to make?
: I was hoping I’d be permitted to help him bathe.
: Hahah! As if that’s an acceptable thing for a high schooler to be doing with her teacher! Hahaha! Hah!
: Well, that wasn’t a suspicious reaction at all.
: You...to...help him...b...what?
: That obviously isn’t going to be approved, Touka. Come up with something else or bow out now.
: Are all of your minds this inappropriate at all times? I’m not insinuating that we’d be in the nude. Sensei would be in a swimsuit. Or even fully clothed for all I care.
: I’d prefer not to bathe fully clothed, thanks.
: Shush, I’m talking to your second mother right now.
: I wonder if this is how Rin feels at home...
: Ami, I would merely be washing his back. And you’d all be there to supervise it. If that is such a problem-
: It is. Vetoed. No.
: That’s all?
: Karin! You’re supposed to be on my team!

: Of course that’s all. Do you really take me for the type of woman to make a move on a man in broad daylight, surrounded by others? I’ve yet to so much as kiss a man. I’m quite far from exhibitionism.
: I don’t really think it’s a problem then. I mean, we’ll all be there to watch...won’t we? As long as it doesn’t get out of hand like last night’s modeling thing, I think it’s fine.
: I have no opinion on this matter as it has never even crossed my mind before. Haha.
: How do you feel about this, Sensei? Are you okay with Touka’s proposal?
: I think a better question is if Touka is okay with Touka’s proposal.
: Thank you for using my real name. But also, why would I not be okay with my own proposal? Assisting your child in the bath is a motherly thing to do, is it not?
: And if I can evoke memories of your childhood, the potential for me to come out on top of Ami becomes much greater than it would otherwise be without doing that.
: All in favor of increasing Touka’s chances to wind up on top of Ami, say aye.
: Then it’s settled!
: Wha- I obviously wasn’t finished! There was more to that sentence!
: It appears our judges have heard all they’ve needed to hear. Now come, child. Mother will take good care of you.
: Please don’t call me “child.”
: Would you prefer “my son?” Or “darling” perhaps?
: None of the above!
: That last one is fine.
: No it’s not! Now stop making the evil Ami come back out!
Somehow or another, the six of us wind up heading over to the baths so Touka can...rub my back and call me her son?
It’s a very Dorm Wars scenario but, at the same time, my life has devolved to the point where even things like this seem pretty normal.
Well, when compared to things like this at least.
: What happened to our conversatiooooooooon!!!!!
: Is this temperature okay for you, my darling? I can always make it a little hotter if you’re not feeling very comfortable.
: This is fine, Touka. Thanks.
: Ah-ah-ah. Who do you think you are, addressing your mother by her first name like that? Mind your manners, dear.
: Karin, why are you covering your face? You’re the one who approved this.
: It...l...looks more...lewd when...I can’t see that...Sensei is...w...wearing...anything...
: Don’t remind me...
: Well, you’re definitely a lock for first place if I decide to grade based on the criteria of how uncomfortable you’ve managed to make everyone else.
: Oh, forget about them. Just focus on me for now.
: Turn around and make her wash your stomach next.
: Forget about her as well.
: In fact, why don’t you be a doll and forget about everything for the next...I don’t know...ten minutes? Twenty? I’m not sure what my time limit is or when I’ll be kicked out of the bath.
: But what I do know is that, like me...you’re very exhausted by all of this, aren’t you?
: I could see it on your face the moment you walked into the room.
: Did something happen? You can tell me about it, you know. Just do it quietly so none of our spectators get jealous and interrupt us.
: Is this mom-Touka or normal Touka speaking right now?

: You know, I’m not quite sure anymore. Because, while it may be the first time I am intentionally slipping into this role, it’s far from the first time I’ve ever felt the...maternal urge to care for you.
: Perhaps it’s just because of my upbringing and how well I’ve been cared for throughout my life...but you really do seem helpless sometimes.
: And that’s enough to make you want to take care of me?
: I suppose it is. Call me soft, but I’m someone who actually feels good when they do nice things for other people. Unlike you, of course — who seems to take joy in toying with kind people like me.
: It’s all in good fun, Thomas.
: I do hope you’ll still find it fun when I accidentally scratch you a few moments from now.
: Accidentally? I welcome the scratching. Have at it.
: You’d say something that suggestive to your very own mother? You’re a sick boy, aren’t you.
: I am definitely not the most-
Touka digs one of her nails into my back just deep enough to get me to twitch. Which either means she is a terrible mother, or she has abandoned that element of care-taking all but completely.
: Hey! What just happened! What are you doing to him?!
: Oh dear...my hand must have slipped. Are you okay, my love?
: Honestly, I didn’t think you had it in-
: Whoops. Slipped again. I’m so, so sorry...
: Okay! That’s it! You’re done!
: Uta! Help me pull them out before Touka damages the goods!
: Uhhhhhh okay! But it’ll be the first time I’m ever touching a boy while he’s in the bath just so everyone knows!
After being forcibly removed from the bath and putting my normal outfit back on, I’m escorted back to the inn and placed promptly into bed so Ami can do...whatever Ami is about to do.

What she won’t do, however, is make physical contact with me- as every single one of her pleas and ideas is ultimately rejected when Karin realizes she can’t so much as watch a girl touch a boy after all.
In fact, she isn’t able to bring herself to watch us even when that isn’t happening. But I suppose thinking too much about Karin while Ami is trying to be a mother figure is kind of rude to-
Actually...I kind of want Karin to compete as well now.
I think she’d be good at this.
I wonder if I’ll be able to convince the rest of the girls to have a turn once Ami is-
: What’s that face for? You’re not thinking of naughty stuff right before bed, are you?
: I think that depends on what your definition of “naughty” is.
: Well, whatever is going on in that head of yours, get it out of there. It’s time to go to sleep or you’ll be late for school tomorrow.
: Is your entire plan just putting me to bed?
: Of course not, silly. That’s just the first part of it.
: Once you wake up in the morning, I have a bunch of other stuff planned.
: Breakfast in bed...a trip to the zoo once class lets out...anything and everything you want to do since you’re my precious little boy.
: And I love you so, so much.
: Now close your eyes.
: Think of your favorite things in the whole wide world.
: And when you wake up, everything will be okay.
: You’ll have everything you could ever want.
: Which means that I’ll have everything I could ever want as well.
: Because all that matters to me is what makes you happy.
: And there is nothing I wouldn’t do to make sure that you’re happy.
: And also, if you vote for Touka over me, I will never make you breakfast again. Okay, goodnight!
: Okay, that’s-
: Mngh...mlm...mnch...chmp...
: Hmngh......mnff....mlmm...hmm.......mmnh....
: Mm...mnfh...mmnch...mmngh...mlm...schlp...chlp....mmm!
: Nff! Mlmf...chlp...schlp....mlfhh......plmgh....mmmf!
: Just...like that...just...hah! Ahh!
: Mm...mmm...mngh...mlm!
: I’m gonna...it’s....hahh!
: Mmf! Mmlgh...mmfhh!
: Cumming...C...Cumming!
: AAAAaaaAAAaaaAAAaaaaaHHHHHhhhh!!!!!
: Mlm.....mlp.....mlmm....
: Aaaaaaahhnnn...
: Exhausted?
: G...Goodnight...
: Nice try, buddy. You still have homework to do. You can go to sleep once that’s done.
: Can’t I just...do it in the morning?
: Mmm....................no. Not happening.
: Come on. Get up. I won’t warn you again.
: Ugh...fine.
: Wow. It’s this late already? I could have sworn it was still, like...noon.
: That’s probably because you didn’t wake up until dinner time...normal people are going to bed right now.
: Well forgive me for wanting to catch up on my beauty sleep, Aki-kun. But, need I remind you, it’s because I sleep so much that I remain so beautiful and energetic for you.
: Right...I’m sure it’s for me.
: Of course it’s for you. It’s just also because I haven’t had a normal sleep schedule since I was your age.
: But that was many moons ago, I’m afraid...
: Are you going to do it again tonight? Stay up late?
: Maybe. Why?
: Are you going to leave again?
: Aww! Are you worried about me?
: No, I just...it’s weird being here when you’re not around...
: Then I suppose there’s nothing I can do but stay in and-
: That’s wrong.
: What? How? I did it exactly how you told me to.
: Noooo. If you did it how I told you to, it wouldn’t be wrong. Let me see.
: Why do I even have to learn English again? It’s not like we ever have to use it here.
: Yeah, but we’ll have to use it everywhere else when we travel the world one day. It’s the universal language, you know. You should take it more seriously, Aki-kun.
: You’re not going to take me anywhere...
: I’m not? Why?
: Yeah, here. Questions 9 and 14. You’re not conjugating correctly. Try again.
: Ugh. Fine.
: Now, wait. Why are you mad at me this time?
: I’m not mad at you...
: Then why are you “whatever you are” at me? And why are you suddenly doubting my desire to take you places when I literally just let you cum in my mouth?
: Because it would look weird.
: You care about how we look?
: I don’t, but...you should. Right? And my brother-
: Your brother has nothing to do with us. That’s a completely different thing.
: And if people think we look weird, we can just say we’re related. Which, technically isn’t even a lie.
: No one’s going to care, Aki-kun. We’ve done it a million times before and haven’t gotten caught yet. Plus, it’s not like you’re going to stay a kid forever.
: If we have to wait to leave the country, that’s fine. I’m not going anywhere.
: Don’t get all silent on me, boy. You know how I feel about that.
: You promise?...
: You’ll really never leave me?...
: Of course.
: But I will not be happy to watch you grow. You’re so cute the way you are now.
: I’m not cute...
: You are very cute.
: Now stop worrying and finish your homework or that pink-haired friend of yours is going to get mad at you again.
: It’d be easier to do that if you’d stop talking to me...
: Then I will sit here in silence, quietly contemplating the many places we will one day see together.
: Good...
: I’m bored.
: Ugh...what am I going to do with you?
: Ami wins.
: But you’ve barely even closed your-
: You win. That’s it. It’s over.
: Sensei, do you maybe wanna like...at least wait until Ami acts stuff out a little longer so it doesn’t seem like you’re just playing favorites?
: Was my performance...somehow inadequate?....
: I don’t mind going through with the whole thing, Sensei. I can do it in hyperspeed if that makes it any-
: There’s no need. You win.
: You win.
Ami wins!
Ami’s affection has gone up by 10!
Several hours later — after bad dreams come to pass and you remember that you will never have anything again.
Then an hour after that — when you realize you never did.
